Class TunableBase

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.tunable.TunableBase
Direct Known Subclasses:
Tunable, TunableBoolean, TunableDouble, TunableFloat, TunableInt, TunableLong
public abstract class TunableBase extends Object
The base class for tunables.

  • Field Details

    • m_changed

      protected boolean m_changed
      Whether the tunable value has changed since the last time it was tuned. This is set to true when set() is called and cleared when notifyTune() is called.

  • Constructor Details

    • TunableBase

      protected TunableBase(TunableConfig config)
      Constructs a tunable base.
      Parameters:
      config - tunable config

    • TunableBase

      protected TunableBase(TunableConfig config, boolean supportsChangeNotification)
      Constructs a tunable base.

      If supportsChangeNotification is true, subclasses must call markChanged() instead of setting m_changed directly.

      Parameters:
      config - tunable config
      supportsChangeNotification - whether the tunable notifies backends when it changes
